gate: DEP-R09 modern explicit near-one density source screen

reading_policy.note: All four newly acquired PDFs had usable native text. Exact statements, exponents, inequalities and source ranges were compared with rendered pages; no OCR transcription was used.

target_contract.required_error_budget_for_printed_coeffi: at most exp(-2), before any additional finite loss
target_contract.screening_rule: A candidate must provide the actual primitive family, numerical multiplier, numerical finite cutoff, exceptional handling and a pointwise prime-count transfer.

source_registry.title: An explicit density estimate for Dirichlet L-series
source_registry.author: Olivier Ramare
source_registry.reason: With T=Q^5 the main term retains log(Q^2 T)^(3+2 delta), while the additive 32 Q^2 log(Q^2 T)^2 term leaves a positive X^(2/D) floor.

source_registry.title: An explicit version of Bombieri's log-free density estimate and Sarkozy's theorem for shifted primes
source_registry.author: Jesse Thorner and Asif Zaman
source_registry.reason: Near exponents 99 and 170 fit below 186, but the fixed prefactors are enormous and no numerical pointwise PAP transfer meeting the exp(-2) budget has been derived. The all-sigma exceptional exponent 198 also exceeds the downstream capacity gate.

source_registry.title: Refinements to the prime number theorem for arithmetic progressions
source_registry.author: Jesse Thorner and Asif Zaman
source_registry.reason: The needed range is structurally available, but the effective multiplier, decay constant and common cutoff are unnamed rather than numerical.

source_registry.title: Large value estimates for Dirichlet polynomials, and the density of zeros of Dirichlet's L-functions
source_registry.author: Bin Chen, Vishal Gupta and Yung Chi Li
source_registry.statements: Theorem 1.2 in the rendered v2 PDF
source_registry.reason: The o(1) factor and its cutoff are not numerical, so the theorem cannot be inserted into a finite X_cert certificate even before pointwise PAP transfer.

source_registry.title: A new bound on the relative error in the Chebotarev density theorem
source_registry.author: Jesse Thorner and Zhuo Zhang
source_registry.reason: The relative-error theorem uses unnamed positive effectively computable constants c_i; cyclotomic specialization therefore does not supply the numerical PAP multiplier and cutoff required here.

source_registry.title: Highly Uniform Prime Number Theorems
source_registry.author: Ikuya Kaneko and Jesse Thorner
source_registry.reason: The dependence is effective in principle but not printed as the numerical Dirichlet pointwise PAP package needed for X_cert.

source_registry.title: Sifting for small primes from an arithmetic progression
source_registry.author: John B. Friedlander and Henryk Iwaniec
source_registry.reason: The x>=q^52600 range is far outside D<=186, the coefficient is far below the required PAP coefficient, pi_f is smoothed, and the exceptional branch invokes a sister source.

source_registry.title: An explicit log-free zero density estimate for Dirichlet L-functions
source_registry.author: Chiara Bellotti and Cruz Castillo
source_registry.reason: The title directly matches the missing component, but no public statement, formula, numerical multiplier or finite cutoff is available to audit.

ramare_direct_insertion.interpretation: These are lower bounds on the numerical upper certificate obtained by directly integrating the theorem RHS, not lower bounds on the true error. They prove only that theorem-only nonnegative insertion cannot meet exp(-2). Hybrid minima, cancellation or a redesigned transfer are not ruled out.

proved_or_exactly_replayed: Ramare T=Q^5 exponent and logarithmic normalization
candidate metadata and published theorem-shape classifications
not_proved: impossibility of every hybrid or cancellation-based use of Ramare's theorem
analytic truth of any source theorem inside Lean
a numerical transfer from modern density estimates to pointwise PAP

next_gate: Do not perform a prime sweep.
